> **Never put secrets in a ticket.** No passwords, keys, tokens, IP addresses, account usernames or
> login URLs. Record **where** something is kept and **who** holds it, not the thing itself.
> Server-specific details belong in the app's own private repository, not in tickets or the shared
> docs site.
